gba.xip.$comment: Linked at 0xDEC00000 -- ld/gba_core.ld, MEMORY region GBA_CODE. Split out and executed from memory-mapped QSPI because RAM_EMU is ~724 KB and gpSP needs ~853 KB.

runtime.$comment: The device save callback always writes the complete gamepak_backup array. It is 128 KiB so this covers 512-byte/8-KiB EEPROM, 32-KiB SRAM, and 64/128-KiB Flash cartridges conservatively.

description.en: Optional. Without it the core uses a bundled free replacement, which a few games dislike.
